checks.description: Generates or uses in-memory image data

description: Create a generated single-image overlay and drape it over Florida. Tests the single-tile provider without depending on a local asset file.
name: archive-single-tile-alert-florida
notes: Imported from optimization/scenarios/cesiumjs-imagery/eval-010. Expected source/runtime contracts are scenario-authored; actual values are observed from the archived baseline generated JS and browser artifacts.

expected_behaviors: Creates a canvas-generated image or other in-memory image URL
Sets a Rectangle.fromDegrees extent over Florida
Adds the single-tile imagery layer to the viewer
preflight.visual_expectations: Florida should show a visible tinted overlay region stretched across the peninsula, making the single-tile overlay obvious against the normal base imagery. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

prompt: Create a CesiumJS viewer centered on Florida. Programmatically generate a simple semi-transparent alert overlay image using an HTML canvas, convert it to a data URL, and use SingleTileImageryProvider.fromUrl to drape that single image over a rectangle covering most of the Florida peninsula. The screenshot should clearly show the red or orange tinted alert overlay stretched over Florida.
